title: Validate Bootstrap Readiness
description: Draft command semantic instance for the standalone whole-platform, all-slices USF bootstrap-readiness validator gate.
purpose: Validate bootstrap-specific readiness invariants before any future bootstrap tag or implementation-start action: required readiness artefacts exist, the implementation directive remains human-only and unsigned, USF-39 remains Backlog, no implementation-shaped roots exist before bootstrap, and the semantic/source-use substrate covers the current all-slices semantic-contract corpus.
outputs: bootstrap validator findings on standard output
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates blocking bootstrap-readiness findings; the validator fails closed on missing required artefacts, readiness overclaims, forbidden implementation roots, missing semantic/source-use substrate, or failed planted-defect selftests.
aiGuidance: Run this gate with validate-spec before claiming bootstrap readiness; it is a whole-platform/all-slices gate and does not authorise implementation, sign USF-100, move USF-39, or claim production readiness.
